exceptions..reaction-bar: post detail uses bordered controls vs flat feed controls; revisit in community design pass
exceptions..reaction-btn: post detail bordered variant; revisit in community design pass

exceptions..abstract: library renders the abstract as a callout box deliberately; global is the plain variant
exceptions..container: six pillar pages deliberately widen the article container (GuideLayout wideContainer pattern)
exceptions..pill: dev/providers.astro is a self-contained sandbox mirror, not a site surface
exceptions..tier-grid: donate fundraiser tiers, STUC membership tiers, and partners showcase are three distinct page designs; revisit if a shared tier component lands
exceptions..tier-badge: three distinct tier-page designs + admin scoreboard chip; unrelated contexts
exceptions..tier-badge--active: admin scoreboard vs partners showcase; unrelated contexts
exceptions..stat-card: page-local data-viz cards (ivf calculator / rrm-success-rates / what-is-rrm) pending a shared stat component
exceptions..author-byline: pillar inline byline vs article flex byline (global) vs glossary avatar byline are different contexts; canonical avatar-stack pattern documented in STYLE-GUIDE

exceptions..admin-bar__site-link: membership.astro snaps the 5px padding to var(--space-1) (4px, same visual scale step); other admin pages still use the literal 5px pending the same admin-chrome token migration
exceptions..admin-bar__link--active: membership.astro fixes a real white-on-white bug (color:var(--white) on background:var(--white)) by using var(--admin-bar-bg) for text; other admin pages (revenue/enrollments/backlinks/seo/content/etc.) still carry the same latent bug, found during Task 5 G3 review, fix not yet ported to those files
